svg.aria-label: 10x: nine agent tools, proof for each. Three chips: install by name, proof for each tool, clear limits. Works in Claude Code and more than 70 other agents; three tools are MCP servers. The commands npx skills add Aboudjem/<tool> -g and claude plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/10x. A 3 by 3 grid of the nine tool logos, each with its first benefit, from sniff (bugs caught before users) to contextify (time saved).
svg.title: 10x: nine agent tools, proof for each
